ownerWords: None of them are convincing for this use case. The 9.0 arms are a maximum 6; driveway-to-paid is ~6.5 - easier on the eyes, structure okay, but the design is not. Needs a one-line opener saying what this is. Price placement: put the price at the bottom of the terms. Verdict: this is not SaaS design - it doesn't feel like SaaS design.
